entities.summary: Political science, also known as the academic field of government, is the scientific study of politics which is a social science dealing with the analysis and implementation of systems of governance and its impact on societies. It deals with systems of governance and power, and the analysis of political activities, political thought, political behavior, and associated constitutions and laws. Specialists in the field, most especially subject-matter experts are known as political scientists.
